name: CN Tower
description: A 553 m communications tower with a glass floor, an outdoor EdgeWalk and views across Lake Ontario.

name: St. Lawrence Market
description: A historic public market with over 120 vendors selling produce, baked goods and the classic peameal bacon sandwich.

name: Royal Ontario Museum
description: Canada's largest museum of world culture and natural history, home to dinosaur galleries and the Crystal wing.

name: Scotiabank Arena
description: Home of the Maple Leafs and the Raptors, also hosting major concerts throughout the year.

name: Kensington Market
description: A multicultural neighbourhood packed with cafes, street food, vintage shops and independent grocers.

name: Ripley's Aquarium of Canada
description: An aquarium with an underwater tunnel, shark lagoon and hands-on touch pools next to the CN Tower.

name: Massey Hall
description: A historic concert hall that has hosted jazz, rock and comedy shows since 1894.

name: High Park
description: A large public park with walking trails, a small zoo and cherry blossoms in the spring.
